sources.title: fitz-ai · PyPI
sources.snippet: Standalone (pip install fitz-ai [code]) — Zero-dependency code retrieval via CodeRetriever. Builds an AST structural index, uses an LLM to select relevant files, expands via import graph and neighbor directories, and returns compressed results.
